```{r, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
my_wd_all_dat <- "project_dir"

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(my_wd_all_dat))
```

## Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Results prediction
pred_bu_res_sfh <- st_read("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_rf_prediction_23_results_bu_res_sfh.gpkg") %>% 
  filter(parceltype == "bu_res_sfh")
pred_bu_res_mfh <- st_read("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_rf_prediction_23_results_bu_res_mfh.gpkg") %>% 
  filter(parceltype == "bu_res_mfh")
pred_bu_nonres <- st_read("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_rf_prediction_23_results_bu_nonres.gpkg") %>% 
  filter(parceltype == "bu_nonres")
pred_nbu <- st_read("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_rf_prediction_23_results_nbu.gpkg") %>% 
  filter(parceltype == "nbu")

# data 2013-2023
data_raw_13 <- st_read("./data_prep_output/parcels_predictors_05_final.gpkg") 

# data 2023
data_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/parcels_predictors_06_2023_final.gpkg") 

# Geometry grid 500m
grid_500_muc <- st_read("./data_input/ispire_grid/DE_Grid_ETRS89-UTM32_500m_muc_raw.gpkg")

# Geometry city districts
bezirke_geom <- st_read("./data_input/administrative_einheiten/stadtbezirke.gpkg")
```

## Scenarios of the results

### Correction factor from actual densification 2013-2023
We create three scenarios: 
- base: Same share of development like 2013-2023 (share_dens_bs)
- half: Half of the development (share_dens_hf)
- double: double (share_dens_db)

```{r}
share_gesamtstadt <-
  data_raw_13 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(parceltype, dep_dens) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dep_dens, values_from = n) %>%
  mutate(share_dens_bs = densification / (nochange + densification),
         bezirk = "Gesamtstadt") %>% 
  mutate(share_dens_hf = share_dens_bs*0.5,
         share_dens_db = share_dens_bs*2)
```

### Join prediction datasets from different parceltypes and add share of development

```{r}
pred_all <- pred_bu_res_sfh %>%
  bind_rows(pred_bu_res_mfh) %>%
  bind_rows(pred_bu_nonres) %>%
  bind_rows(pred_nbu) %>%
  select(
    id_par_merge,
    parceltype,
    bezirk,
    bezirksteil,
    predicted,
    prob_dens,
    fa_23,
    dif_fa_absolut_predicted
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  left_join(
    share_gesamtstadt %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(parceltype, share_dens_hf, share_dens_bs, share_dens_db)
  )
```

### Derive parcels with top probability for development by parceltype

```{r}
slice_top_prob <- function(pred_all, scenariotype) {
  pred_top_scenario <-
    pred_all %>%
    split(.$parceltype) %>%
    map_dfr(function(df) {
      prop_val <- df %>%
        distinct({{scenariotype}}) %>%
        pull()
      
      df %>%
        arrange(desc(prob_dens)) %>%
        slice_head(prop = prop_val)
    }) %>%
    mutate(base_scenario = TRUE)
  
  pred_top_scenario
}
```

```{r}
pred_top_bs <- slice_top_prob(pred_all, share_dens_bs) %>%
  transmute(id_par_merge, bs_scenario = base_scenario)

pred_top_hf <- slice_top_prob(pred_all, share_dens_hf) %>%
  transmute(id_par_merge, hf_scenario = base_scenario)

pred_top_db <- slice_top_prob(pred_all, share_dens_db) %>%
  transmute(id_par_merge, db_scenario = base_scenario)
```

### Join data together and back to original dataset

```{r}
dat_scenarios_fin <- pred_all %>% 
  left_join(pred_top_bs) %>% 
  left_join(pred_top_hf) %>% 
  left_join(pred_top_db) 
```


## Aggregate results to gridlevel (500m)
### Join grid id to parcels

```{r}
grid_500_par <- st_filter(grid_500_muc, data_raw, .predicate = st_intersects) %>%
  transmute(grid_id_500 = id)

grid_500_par_sfh <- st_filter(grid_500_muc,
                              data_raw %>% filter(parceltype == "bu_res_sfh"),
                              .predicate = st_intersects) %>%
  transmute(grid_id_500 = id)

grid_500_par_mfh <- st_filter(grid_500_muc,
                              data_raw %>% filter(parceltype == "bu_res_mfh"),
                              .predicate = st_intersects) %>%
  transmute(grid_id_500 = id)

grid_500_par_nonres <- st_filter(grid_500_muc,
                                 data_raw %>% filter(parceltype == "bu_nonres"),
                                 .predicate = st_intersects) %>%
  transmute(grid_id_500 = id)

grid_500_par_nbu <- st_filter(grid_500_muc,
                              data_raw %>% filter(parceltype == "nbu"),
                              .predicate = st_intersects) %>%
  transmute(grid_id_500 = id)

centroids_results <- data_raw %>%
  select(id_par_merge) %>%
  left_join(dat_scenarios_fin %>% select(-c(
    share_dens_hf, share_dens_bs, share_dens_db
  ))) %>%
  st_centroid()

centroids_grid <- st_join(centroids_results, grid_500_par) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
```

### Function to aggregate results to any spatial level

```{r}
aggregate_results <- function(dat_scenarios_fin, scenariotype, aggregationlevel, all_parcels_2023) {
  
  # aggregate number and fa of all parcels in aggregationlevel (needed to later calculate relative change)
  par_all <- all_parcels_2023 %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(parceltype, {{aggregationlevel}}) %>%
    summarise(n_par_all = n(), fa_23_par_all = sum(fa_23)) %>%
    bind_rows(
      all_parcels_2023 %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        group_by({{aggregationlevel}}) %>%
        summarise(n_par_all = n(), fa_23_par_all = sum(fa_23)) %>%
        mutate(parceltype = "all")
    ) %>%
    mutate(fa_23_par_all = if_else(fa_23_par_all == 0, 1, fa_23_par_all)) #would lead to divided by 0
  
  # aggregate by aggregation level and parcel type
  results_aggregated <- dat_scenarios_fin %>%
    filter({{scenariotype}} == TRUE) %>%
    group_by({{aggregationlevel}}, parceltype) %>%
    summarise(
      n_par = n(),
      dif_fa = sum(dif_fa_absolut_predicted),
      .groups = "drop" # makes sure that there is a zero, if no pacel occurs in a bezirk)
    ) %>%
    complete({{aggregationlevel}}, parceltype, fill = list(n_par = 0, dif_fa = 0))
  
  # aggregate by aggregation level and sum up all parcel types
  results_all <- results_aggregated %>%
    group_by({{aggregationlevel}}) %>%
    summarise(n_par = sum(n_par), dif_fa = sum(dif_fa)) %>%
    mutate(parceltype = "all")
  
  # join all and calculate relative change
  results_join <- results_aggregated %>%
    bind_rows(results_all) %>%
    left_join(par_all) %>%
    mutate(n_par_share = n_par / n_par_all,
           dif_fa_share = dif_fa / fa_23_par_all)
  
  results_join
}
```

### Run function for 500 m gridlevel

```{r}
# run function
results_grid_bs_scenario <- aggregate_results(centroids_grid, bs_scenario, grid_id_500, centroids_grid) %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "base")

results_grid_hf_scenario <- aggregate_results(centroids_grid, hf_scenario, grid_id_500, centroids_grid) %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "half")

results_grid_db_scenario <- aggregate_results(centroids_grid, db_scenario, grid_id_500, centroids_grid) %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "double")

# Join results and add geometry
results_all <- results_grid_bs_scenario %>%
  bind_rows(results_grid_hf_scenario) %>%
  bind_rows(results_grid_db_scenario)

results_grid_all_scenarios <- grid_500_par %>% 
  left_join(results_all)
```

## Aggregate results to city districts

```{r}
# run function
results_bezirk_bs_scenario <- aggregate_results(dat_scenarios_fin, bs_scenario, bezirk, pred_all) %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "base")

results_bezirk_hf_scenario <- aggregate_results(dat_scenarios_fin, hf_scenario, bezirk, pred_all) %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "half")

results_bezirk_db_scenario <- aggregate_results(dat_scenarios_fin, db_scenario, bezirk, pred_all) %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "double")

# join all scenarios  and add geometry
results_all <- results_bezirk_bs_scenario %>%
  bind_rows(results_bezirk_hf_scenario) %>%
  bind_rows(results_bezirk_db_scenario)

results_bezirk_all_scenarios <- bezirke_geom %>% transmute(sb_nummer, bezirk = name) %>%
  left_join(results_all)
```

